brief:
London's Metropolitan Police said it will take no action over a social media post by Sarah Helm, wife of the UK prime minister's national security adviser, after she faced accusations of expressing pro-Palestine views online, Middle East Eye reported.

The decision ends the inquiry into Helm's post without criminal charges or further investigation. The case had drawn attention given her husband's position advising the prime minister on national security matters.

title: Met Police closes case against PM aide's wife over pro-Palestine post
